description: Spread enemy stats along a curve for smooth difficulty progression. Give the enemies ordered from weakest to strongest; the first gets each curve's `start`, the last its `end`, the rest are interpolated with the chosen shape. Curves can target any parameter (mhp, mmp, atk, def, mat, mdf, agi, luk) plus `exp` and `gold`. Dry run by default - shows before and after per enemy; pass dryRun=false to write.

exponent.description: Power for ease shapes (default 2), steepness for logistic (default 8)

start.description: Value at the first point of the curve

enemyIds.description: Enemy ids from weakest to strongest

name: generate_enemy_scaling
title: Generate enemy scaling
